title: Structured-polar proposal and objectness failure attribution
purpose: Determine whether the sealed 180x2 top-16 candidates contain sufficient typed spatial proposals for one minimal objectness corrective or whether the dense event route must stop.

approval.scope: One immutable read-only C07-C08 attribution over the three sealed structured-polar top16 archives; zero training, new inference, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed automatic best-choice execution without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed Observable Spatial Event Teacher V2 C07-C08 targets.
Three sealed StructuredPolarMultiDepth C07-C08 top16 prediction archives.
Sealed same-population exclusive-center and other baseline metrics.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.independent_sampling_unit: C07-C08 world and objective event identity.
sampling.temporal_context: No sensor read; audit sealed five-frame outputs.
sampling.rule: Use every sealed selection row, target and top16 prediction exactly once. No resampling, prediction mutation, threshold calibration or checkpoint selection.

teacher.source: Observable Teacher V2 terminal/junction type, robot-relative xyz, mask and Teacher-only identity.
teacher.student_input: No student execution; evaluator reads sealed predictions only.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Attribution only; no graph or planner output.

split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: None; replay each seed's sealed 0.95 threshold and compute oracle/ranking diagnostics that are forbidden from deployment selection.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Formal command binds only the sealed C07-C08 Teacher and completed capacity-run hashes.

methods.main: Replay sealed 0.95 metrics; compute all-top16 typed and position-only 4m one-to-one oracle recall, confidence ranking labels, slot0/slot1 and same-bin selected false positives, empty-row cardinality, deterministic one-per-bin and Teacher-cardinality upper bounds, plus distance/type strata.
methods.baseline: Same-population exclusive-center recall=0.262905 and F1=0.390133; best second-depth recall=0.139241.
methods.fallback: If any seed typed oracle recall is below baseline recall+0.10, stop the dense proposal route. Otherwise distinguish deterministic duplicate/cardinality recovery from an objectness-supervision failure; no corrective training occurs inside this audit.

acceptance.population: Exactly 20 worlds, 45942 observations, 33145 targets, 6073 multi-event rows, 79 second-depth targets and 275 identities.
acceptance.decision: Emit exactly one frozen outcome: STOP_DENSE_PROPOSAL_ROUTE, ONE_PER_BIN_CORRECTIVE_JUSTIFIED, CARDINALITY_RANKING_CORRECTIVE_JUSTIFIED, or FROZEN_GEOMETRY_OBJECTNESS_REFIT_REQUIRED.
acceptance.proposal_gate: All-seed typed top16 oracle recall >= exclusive recall +0.10.
acceptance.deterministic_corrective_gate: All-seed one-per-bin or Teacher-cardinality diagnostic F1 >= exclusive F1 +0.05.
acceptance.system: Zero optimizer, new inference, threshold selection, C09/C10/M-TARE; source unchanged and complete plot/seal.

failure_policy: Any source/count/join/metric/decision ambiguity or forbidden read fails closed. Do not change predictions, Teacher, model or official threshold.
retention: Retain full summary, per-seed proposal/ranking/slot/cardinality/range evidence, CSV, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, logs and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU read-only deterministic matching over three sealed archives; no model inference.
